vx_histogram — VX pixel op

• Data kinds: image2d → pairs

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.vx_histogram(image, *, num_bins, offset, range_) (to call the implementation directly, import vxcore; vxcore.vx_histogram(image, *, num_bins, offset, range_); from the registry, opsvx.get("vx_histogram"))

Usage

Histogram (Section 3.26): a pixel value I goes into the bin i = (I − offset) × numBins / range (offset ≤ I < offset + range, REQ-0230). Pixels outside the range are not counted. The bin is determined by integer division (truncation).

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

返り値 (num_bins, 2) の pairs: 列 0 = 升の下端の画素値(offset + i·range/numBins)、列 1 = 数。

Raises ValueError: U8 の 2-D でない / num_bins・range_ が正でない / num_bins > range_ / offset が負。
